# Double Crux

<p class="lens-meta"><code class="lens-code">DOUBLECRUX</code> · Modern — analytic and scientific method · <strong>Catalogued — a reading, owns no gate</strong></p>

## The failure it names

disagreement that circles because the load-bearing belief was never located

## What it does

find the belief whose reversal would reverse the conclusion, for both parties

## Worked example

If neither side can name what would change their mind, the dispute is not yet about anything checkable.

- <https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/exa5kmvopeRyfJgCy/double-crux-a-strategy-for-resolving-disagreement>
